currentScene.explanation: Interactive Casimir effect simulation showing two parallel conductive plates with quantum vacuum fluctuations. Particles outside plates thrive while those between plates are suppressed due to boundary conditions, creating pressure difference that pushes plates together. User can drag plates to change gap and observe force change.
